lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 distinct high-contrast white vertical stripes observed across the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-torso region, with slightly increased intervals toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A minor bifurcation (Y-split) is visible at the dorsal origin of the fourth primary stripe from the anterior. A diagonal merging segment connects the eighth and ninth stripes near the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The leftmost anterior stripe is abbreviated, terminating in the upper shoulder region. The final two posterior stripes show significant discontinuity, fragmenting into dashes and isolated spots toward the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized grouping of approximately 6-8 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch and the proximal segment of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots forms a semi-linear geometric row across the mid-thigh area.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the ocular regions; two distinct white circular spots on the lower cheek; white ventral neck patch; black pigmentation on the distal hoof segments.
